title: Rollercoaster Tycoon IN SPACE!
author: stickfigure
selftext:
This is current in-game footage of the current playable demo. 

\-

Are any of you Rollercoaster Tycoon or Sim Theme Park nerds? I grew up with both, and never liked the newer coaster games, just never satisfied the same itch. 

I'm building a browser-first variant inspired by both!

If you'd like to test the alpha, it's here: https://wondervoid.space

I'd really appreciate feedback! 

(Does not support phones yet, soon!) 

Note: All art, sounds and assets are human made; used a mixture of Opus and Fabel for coding.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body:
Its a cool concept thus far, and a good start for an alpha. Some feedback points:

1. Onboarding needs improving. The cat on upper right on the start but I have no clue what I am building. You need to help me (the player) actually build something and also understand with what I am building, what will the impact.
2. Building a bath is a little bit clunky. Also the paths need turn graphics and connecting graphics for when paths connect

Do you have data analytics setup for capturing what users are doing and when they drop off?

And if you haven't already one so, enter your game into the [AI Game Festival,](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/view/standalone) you probably have a good chance for the winning the free token.

replies.author: stickfigure
replies.body:
This is excellent feedback, really appreciate it! Will work on these. 

For the moment, no, no analytics, I wanted it to be similar to school CDs which didn't need to maintain a connection to play the game; I'll think about this though ✳️ 

Aw, that really makes my day, I didn't even know those contests exist, will look them up :)

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body: Not having analytics is shooting yourself in the foot, and most analytics are free. Watch here on this implementation with ClaudeCraft: [https://youtu.be/hGWB0W1roug](https://youtu.be/hGWB0W1roug)
